title: Onboarding's 'Getting Started' opens the API Guide's 'Getting Started' page
clean: Opening Getting Started in the Onboarding book shows the first-day checklist (collect laptop from the IT desk on floor 3, meet buddy at 11:00).
with_bug: It shows the API Guide's Getting Started page instead (base URL, first API request), a lookalike with the same title.
mechanism: Theme functions.php (web_middleware_before): requests for /books/onboarding/page/getting-started are redirected to /books/api-guide/page/getting-started.
